optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Planned supplier onboarding projects for 23 suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining milestone schedules in the programme tracker.
professionalSummary.witness: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.

professionalSummary.text: Tracked integration milestones with three integration engineers, updating weekly status in the programme tracker and resolving delays in weekly reviews.
professionalSummary.witness: Tracked integration milestones with the three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review and agreeing recovery dates with the supplier contact and the engineer concerned.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced average supplier onboarding time from 46 days to 29 days across 17 suppliers after introducing standard mapping templates, as recorded against the baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated onboarding decisions with programme lead (supplier sequencing) and customer operations (go-live confirmation), documenting responsibility boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations; the programme lead decided supplier sequencing and customer operations confirmed each go-live with the manufacturer.

professionalSummary.text: Documented limitations and hand-over conditions for each completed onboarding in completion notes, verified by programme tracker records.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the completion note for each onboarded supplier, listing open mapping limitations and the hand-over points for the support team.

experienceHighlights.text: Introduced standard mapping templates that reduced onboarding time by 37% (46 to 29 days) across 17 suppliers, verified by programme tracker data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained programme tracker as single source of truth for supplier status, with 23 suppliers across two manufacturers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Supplier completion note listing open mapping limitations and hand-over points for support team, verified by programme tracker.

skills.witness: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.
